verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents official SDKs that share one identity, event, and consent model and one API surface across web, mobile, server, and game engines. Unified SDKs cover multiple products, Experiment SDKs support local flag evaluation, and a wizard installs the right SDK for your framework; Flutter and React Native SDKs are also listed. One community report calls implementation hard, which lowers confidence but does not contradict that the SDKs exist and work. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, and a detailed per-language list or reference-doc evidence.
